sections.intro: If you can unequip or switch off the drone, run the same short route once with it and once without it. If the times are close, repeat the pair in reverse order so the drone run goes first. Write down any interruption that would explain a large difference, such as stopping to retrace your route. Base your next run on where you saw a difference. For example, if pickup was quicker but the payout took just as long, pay attention to the trip after collection before changing how you clear the pile.
